# Dependencies for the engine-only ENDURANCE bootstrap.
# Keep optional applications, examples, tests and installation targets out.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build bundled dependencies statically" FORCE)
if(MSVC)
    set(USE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY_DLL OFF CACHE BOOL "Use the static MSVC runtime" FORCE)
endif()

set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Build GLFW examples" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build GLFW tests" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build GLFW documentation" FORCE)
set(GLFW_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Install GLFW" FORCE)
set(TERMCOLOR_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build termcolor tests" FORCE)
set(TINYOBJLOADER_BUILD_TEST_LOADER OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the OBJ example loader" FORCE)
set(TINYOBJLOADER_BUILD_OBJ_STICHER OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the OBJ stitching utility" FORCE)

# The six CPU libraries used by the engine remain enabled with BUILD_BULLET3=OFF.
set(BUILD_BULLET3 OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the optional Bullet 3 GPU libraries" FORCE)
set(BUILD_CPU_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build Bullet CPU examples" FORCE)
set(BUILD_BULLET2_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build Bullet 2 examples" FORCE)
set(BUILD_OPENGL3_DEMOS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build Bullet OpenGL examples" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PYBULLET OFF CACHE BOOL "Build the Python bindings" FORCE)
set(BUILD_UNIT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build Bullet tests" FORCE)
set(BUILD_EXTRAS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build Bullet extras" FORCE)
set(USE_GRAPHICAL_BENCHMARK OFF CACHE BOOL "Enable the Bullet graphical benchmark" FORCE)
set(INSTALL_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Install Bullet libraries" FORCE)
set(INSTALL_CMAKE_FILES OFF CACHE BOOL "Install Bullet CMake files" FORCE)

set(LIBTYPE STATIC CACHE STRING "Build OpenAL as a static library" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build OpenAL utilities" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Build OpenAL examples" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Install OpenAL" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL_CONFIG OFF CACHE BOOL "Install OpenAL sample configuration" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL_HRTF_DATA OFF CACHE BOOL "Install external OpenAL HRTF data" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL_AMBDEC_PRESETS OFF CACHE BOOL "Install OpenAL presets" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Install OpenAL examples" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_INSTALL_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "Install OpenAL utilities" FORCE)
set(ALSOFT_UPDATE_BUILD_VERSION OFF CACHE BOOL "Read OpenAL version from Git" FORCE)
# Preserve the bundled audio library's default embedded HRTF behavior.
set(ALSOFT_EMBED_HRTF_DATA ON CACHE BOOL "Embed the bundled default HRTF data" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(glfw)
add_subdirectory(glew)
add_subdirectory(termcolor)
add_subdirectory(tinyobjloader)
add_subdirectory(OpenFBX)
add_subdirectory(stb-cmake)
add_subdirectory(glm)
add_subdirectory(imgui-cmake)
add_subdirectory(Bullet3)
add_subdirectory(openal-soft)

if(ENDURANCE_ENABLE_NETWORK)
    add_subdirectory(hv)
    add_subdirectory(steamworks_sdk)
endif()
